intro.title: Technology That Puts Patients and Clinicians First
paragraphs: Healthcare teams lose hours every day to paperwork, phone calls and systems that do not talk to each other. Patients wait on hold, records sit in silos and staff re-enter the same information again and again. The right software removes that friction, so clinicians spend more time on care.

We are a healthcare software development company building custom solutions for hospitals, clinics, diagnostic labs, pharmacies and health-tech startups. Our team designs hospital management systems, patient portals, telemedicine platforms, appointment and IVR automation, and integrations with EHR and EMR systems using standards like HL7 and FHIR.

Every project is built with patient data security at its core: encryption, role-based access, audit trails and HIPAA-aligned practices. See our <work>healthcare case studies</work>, explore <csd>custom software development</csd> or <contact>talk to us about your facility</contact>.

faqs.title: Healthcare Software Development FAQs
faqs.subtitle: Quick answers for healthcare providers and health-tech founders.

items.a: Healthcare software development is building digital systems for hospitals, clinics, labs, pharmacies and health-tech companies, such as hospital management systems, patient portals, telemedicine apps and EHR integrations.

items.q: Do you build HIPAA-compliant healthcare software?
items.a: We build healthcare software with HIPAA-aligned practices, including encryption, role-based access, audit trails and secure hosting, and work with your compliance team on policies and certification.

items.q: Can you integrate with our existing EHR or EMR system?
items.a: Yes. We integrate with EHR, EMR, lab and pharmacy systems using HL7, FHIR or available APIs, and validate data mapping carefully to keep records accurate.
Yes. We build telemedicine platforms with video consultations, appointment booking, e-prescriptions, payments and follow-up reminders on web, Android and iOS.

items.q: How much does healthcare software development cost?
items.a: A clinic system or patient app typically costs $8,000 to $25,000, telemedicine or portal platforms $25,000 to $70,000, and hospital management systems $70,000 or more.

items.q: Can you help healthcare startups build an MVP?
items.a: Yes. We help health-tech founders scope, design and launch an MVP quickly, with privacy and scalability in mind from the start.
